about: Every value plotted in docs/figures/*.svg, with the file, SHA-256 and field it was read from. Generated; never edit by hand.

hero-shrinking-cost.caption: Pre-registered condition: darkness (Brokkr) s5 (H21). 9 models, 10,000 test images; bars are 95% paired intervals (one narrower than its marker is hidden behind it). H21 predicted a large extra gap (the shrinking cost under the damage minus the shrinking cost on clean images, as defined in docs/hypotheses_stage4.md) in at least 5 of the 9 models; 2 showed it; verdict FAIL. The dashed line is the label's large-cost line (whole interval more than 5 points below full size), adopted for the labels after these results existed; it is not what H21 judged.

grid-shrinking-cost.caption: Exploratory, not pre-registered. Every usable INT8 build in the released labels, 10,000 test images per condition. Shrinking cost = INT8 minus FP32 top-1 on the same images; each cell's hover note gives its 95% paired interval. Colour: the measured cost. Dot: large cost (whole interval more than 5 points below full size). Grey with a dash: near floor (FP32 below 10% top-1), where a small cost proves nothing. Rows are sorted by their number of large costs.

mnv3l-uncertainty.caption: MobileNetV3-Large, 10,000 test images per condition; bars are 95% intervals (one narrower than its marker is hidden behind it). Prediction sets were calibrated on clean images (5,000 conformal-calibration images) for a 90% target; under damage there is no 90% promise. The dashed 80% line is the label's coverage line. Coverage is always shown with its average set size.

mnv3l-clean-accuracy.caption: MobileNetV3-Large, clean test split, 10,000 images (Stage 1 and Stage 3 records). Each interval is a 95% bootstrap interval for one build on its own, not a paired comparison between builds. Exact score ties are broken toward the lower class number; tied images: FP32 (full precision): 0; INT8 (min-max calibration): 262; INT8 (percentile calibration, 99.99%): 110.
mnv3l-clean-accuracy.alt: FP32 (full precision): 75.6% (74.7% to 76.5%); INT8 (min-max calibration): 60.2% (59.1% to 61.1%); INT8 (percentile calibration, 99.99%): 73.6% (72.7% to 74.5%)

speed-ratio.caption: Laptop latency on 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1235U, Windows 11, batch 1. Pinned to the laptop's 2 performance cores (4 hardware threads, as reported by Windows); the 4-thread setting therefore runs on 2 physical cores, and the pin was not read back. Each ratio is INT8's p50 divided by FP32's p50, each the median across 10 sessions. Hollow marker: speed varied a lot between repeat runs (spread above 10.0%) for INT8 or FP32; treat as rough. A relative comparison on one laptop CPU only, not a measure of speed on edge devices.
